title: Co-founded SOHO China with Zhang Xin in 1995
statement: Co-founded SOHO China with Zhang Xin in 1995, building it into a major Beijing-focused office developer.

title: Pursued a sale of the couple's controlling SOHO China stake to
statement: Pursued a sale of the couple's controlling SOHO China stake to Blackstone Group starting in 2020, and after that deal fell through, resigned as chairman effective September 7, 2022.
outcome: The Blackstone sale collapsed in September 2021 amid an insider-trading probe involving SOHO China's CFO; Pan formally resigned as chairman a year later (September 2022), remaining an executive director while relocating primarily to the United States.
